Hockenheimring survey

Germany · German GP · theme green, day only (night:false, lamp:"none") · classic circuit · branch cursor/hockenheim-survey-a1 · base sha fbfa1d3 (+ shot-tooling and day-wet-lighting merges) · 72 frames, TLX/SwiftShader, 2026-10-15. Read-only survey: no js/css edited.

Top findings: (1) Ostkurve stand/gravel/tyre wall sit on a 550-640 m radius straight; (2) forest reads sparse, not a wall; (3) Motodrom terraces are detached blocks; (4) leaning hoardings look like loose boards; (5) day fog/overcast keep a saturated blue sky. Banking, elevation, audit and verify-track are clean.

6. Ranked defects

1. Ostkurve furniture sits on a straight ~600 m past its corner
Where: js/circuits/scenery/hockenheim.js:401-405 (groundPatch K(0.335), tyreWall 0.325-0.350, grandstandEx(0.340,…concrete), marshalPost 0.345)
Evidence: Measured radius at 0.335/0.340 is 553/636 m (straight); the nearest turns are T2-T4 at 0.188-0.218. Frame #03: a large pale concrete slab and a sand patch beside a plain straight, no corner. Def comment at js/circuits/hockenheim.js:41 says the bank zone was re-seated from 0.335 to turn 4 (apex 0.218) but the scenery was not.
Suggested fix (not applied): Re-seat to the T2-T4 complex (~0.19-0.22, outside of the corner) or drop the stand/tyre wall; keep the doc table in docs/tracks/hockenheim.md in step. Parent to confirm the real Ostkurve sequence before moving.
2. Hardtwald reads as scattered trees, not the continuous wall the brief demands
Where: js/circuits/scenery/hockenheim.js:40-63 (forestEdge), :64-92 (every passes); def js/circuits/hockenheim.js:20-21 dressingExclusions
Evidence: Frames #03/#04/#05 (and the trackside set) show wide bare tan verge, clear daylight between pines, and the flat green ridge slabs (:425-437) visible as boxes on the horizon. verify-track reports guard drops tree=74 pine=7 motorhome=2, so some placements are culled; the forestEdge tiers (0.86/0.62/0.2 density) do not close the gap in the frames.
Suggested fix (not applied): Measure forestEdge instance count per side and per cull reason (scenery debug counters); raise density or pull the first belt to ~5 m. Do not add hard prism slabs (clip audit). Needs a capture A/B.
3. Motodrom terracing reads as detached stair blocks with daylight between them
Where: js/circuits/scenery/hockenheim.js:110-126 (motodromTerrace seg=min(spacing*0.78, spacing-1.2), step 12/13) and :129,:132
Evidence: Frame #06 and trackside #72 (top-down): separate stepped blocks with clear gaps, each with a differently coloured crowd slab; docs/tracks/hockenheim.md section 6 says the bowl must be a continuous rake. The code comment shows the gap was introduced on purpose to dodge flatCoplanar/clip.
Suggested fix (not applied): Close the gap with a continuous skirt/back wall behind the rows (not coplanar with the risers) rather than widening seg; re-run audit-circuit (clip cap 2 and coplanar cap 4 have no headroom).
4. Loose, tilted hoarding/fence planks look like boards lying on the infield
Where: js/circuits/scenery/hockenheim.js:416-418 (fence, kit fence "leaning"), :468-477 (sponsorHoarding)
Evidence: Frame #06 and the trackside #72: dark and red/blue slats at odd angles across the infield side of T11-T14. The def sets kit.fence:"leaning" (js/circuits/hockenheim.js:63), which is the likely cause of the lean. Brief calls for low flush hoarding.
Suggested fix (not applied): Use an upright fence kit for the stadium section or limit the leaning kit to the forest; verify with a trackside capture.
5. Day fog keeps a saturated blue sky and overcast barely changes the scene
Where: Engine/lighting, not circuit data: js/lighting/atmosphere.js (not read in this survey; mechanism UNCERTAIN). Palette: js/circuits/hockenheim.js:22-24 zenith [0.26,0.44,0.72]
Evidence: Frames #31-#36 (fog): scene fades toward grey while the sky stays deep blue; #37-#42 (overcast) look nearly identical to dry (blue sky, only slightly dimmer); rain/storm (#19-#30) do go grey, so the merged day-wet-lighting change works for those two but not fog/overcast. Possibly a sky-vs-fog colour mismatch.
Suggested fix (not applied): Report to the lighting owner (skill lighting-tuner); check whether fog/overcast blend the sky through the same path as rain/storm.
6. Tree tiers show a black ring under each crown
Where: Shared pine()/tree() emitters (js/track/, not circuit data); used at hockenheim.js:73-91
Evidence: Frames #03/#05 and trackside #70/#71: dark band between pine tiers, visible in all weathers. Probably the underside of the cone tier prisms; not circuit specific (UNCERTAIN, not read).
Suggested fix (not applied): Parent: inspect pine() tier underside colour in js/track scenery API.
7. Very large flat grey plane fills the left foreground at the start/finish orbit; trackside frame #67 looks at a blank wall
Where: js/circuits/scenery/hockenheim.js:362-363 (grandstandEx Haupttribüne side -1) is the likely source; UNCERTAIN
Evidence: Frame #01, #13 etc. The orbit camera at frac 0 is above/behind the Haupttribüne; the roof/back wall fills a third of the frame. Probably a camera framing issue rather than a prop defect.
Suggested fix (not applied): Ignore for scenery; if a hero shot of S/F is wanted, use --az/--dist overrides.
8. Hairpin legs only ~43 m apart (centre-to-centre) and the hairpin stand is a 3-row box rake
Where: Centreline at 0.445 vs 0.480 (measured); scenery:385-396
Evidence: The Spitzkehre is a tight R 12 m at 0.463 with hw 6.2 m; the temporary stand is skipped where onTrack() fires. Not rendered in any survey frame (frac 0.46 not in the 6-position matrix).
Suggested fix (not applied): Capture a frac 0.46 orbit before judging. UNVERIFIED visually.
9. Audit ceilings have zero headroom
Where: tools/track/audit-circuit.cjs: clip 2 (cap 2), coplanar 4 (cap 4), ground flatCoplanar 1 (baseline)
Evidence: Any new scenery risks tripping the baselines; baselines must not be loosened.
Suggested fix (not applied): Fix existing spots first, then lower caps.

7. Code & scenery deep-dive

  • Layout: OSM trace (bacinger/f1-circuits, ODbL) of 4559 m; built 4539.9 m. Radii in the corner table are consistent with the real hairpin R~12 m. The longest straight measures 432 m on a 900 m radius criterion; the real Parabolika is much longer, so the OSM-derived straights or the trace's simplification may be shortening it (UNVERIFIED).
  • Elevation: three authored bumps (def :27-31) give a 9.2 m range; matches the brief's 3.5/5/4 m numbers. Real site is flat; no surveyed profile read.
  • Width: hwZones at index fractions 0.3624-0.4169 (arc 0.435-0.480) and 0.815-0.960; the def comment documents the index-to-arc offset. Motodrom width 6.6 m half is narrower than 7.5 m elsewhere.
  • Frac frames: scenery uses racing fractions (sceneryCoordinates:"racing"), no _sceneryShift (startFrac 0), so scenery fracs and turn fracs share one frame; the Ostkurve mismatch is therefore a content error, not a shift error.
  • Guards: 74 trees, 7 pines and 2 motorhomes are culled by the engine guards; foliage is also excluded 0.78-0.06 and 0.40-0.50 (def :17-18).
  • Assets: all dressing is procedural boxes/cylinders/prisms plus 12 model groups (6 distinct plus six pit bays); the baked PBR pack is the only texture source. No lamps, bridges, tunnels or water.

8. Not captured / uncertain

  • No frames at frac 0.46 (Spitzkehre), 0.62 (T7) or 0.99; hairpin stand and forest-exit gravel are unseen.
  • Overcast, wet and rain frames judged from contact sheets, not at full size. Dusk and night with other weathers (fog, storm) not captured, trimmed for time.
  • Real-world facts are from the in-repo brief; not re-fetched. East stand and Mercedes-Tribüne placement remain uncertain.
  • Engine attributions in defects 5 and 6 are unread source: UNCERTAIN.
  • Filename convention used in the gallery is hockenheim-nn-view-fPP-tod-weather (tod before weather) so build-gallery can parse tod and condition. "storm" is not in the builder's WEATHER_TAIL list, so storm frames may file under tod "unknown" (checked below).
  • Renderer: TLX on SwiftShader, no real GPU; shading and bloom are not evidence about a player's GPU.
